name: pulse
summary: Band-limited pulse/square (2nd-order polyBLEP, two BLEPs — one per edge). `width` (Q15, default 0.5 = square) is the duty — the high fraction of the cycle; a settable param, clamped to [0.01, 0.99] so the two BLEPs never collide into a narrow-pulse artifact. `inc` note-derived; `inv_inc` = 2^32/inc (note-on reciprocal).
